title: Start the system: W14's fix done on the card (each source's terms), other fixes in a drawer
why: Jason, 2026-11-18, on W14's 'Fix it' (a link to Pulse): 'Fix it can't take me to another page. I already explained this.' 1. W14, held by a hub's licence sources whose terms aren't read, lists each source on the card with Read its terms (the source's own terms page, opened beside this one to read) and Terms read: allowed, done right there (HubOpening's own step, with its permission hubs.open); Check again carries on once they're read. Blocked sources aren't listed (never read by the crawler). 2. Any other fix that needs another page opens in a drawer over the card (Fix it here), never by leaving it. 3. A held step with its own fixes listed doesn't repeat them in its status line. 4. FAQ.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
